verdict.rationale: Kushki documents an official client-side JavaScript library (kushki.js / 'Librería JS'), which is used for card tokenization and 3DS integration. That is a first-party SDK, but the evidence shows only this single front-end library, with no breadth of language SDKs. The e-commerce plugins are platform integrations rather than SDKs and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: server-side SDKs in common languages, SDK reference docs or repositories, versioning/install details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
